datasets.name: fct_crimes
datasets.description: Core crime incident fact table. Granularity: 1 row per incident (1997-2024). All crime KPIs aggregate from this table via dimension joins. Crime incident semantic model. Primary entity: crime_incident. Joins to geo, date, offense, agency via foreign keys.

fields.name: agency
fields.description: FK to dim_agency (nullable for unmatched agencies)

datasets.name: fct_income_population
datasets.description: Annual county income and population snapshot fact. Granularity: 1 row per county per year (1997-2024). County income and population semantic model. Granularity: 1 row per county per year.

fields.name: year_date
fields.description: Synthetic Jan-1-of-year date; the real time dimension backing agg_time_dimension for this model.

datasets.name: fct_business_subsidy_tiers
datasets.description: B.A.S.E. program core output. One row per eligible business with composite subsidy tier. This is the central deliverable of the B.A.S.E. program.

fields.name: formation_date
fields.description: Date the business was registered with CDOS. Used as the semantic model time spine.

fields.name: date
fields.description: String surrogate key in MM/DD/YYYY format; join key from fct_crimes.

fields.name: date_day
fields.description: The actual DATE value for this row.

datasets.name: dim_geography
datasets.description: Conformed geography dimension. One row per city+county or county-only entry. Provides surrogate keys for all geo joins.

fields.name: city_name
fields.description: City name or '[County Level]' for county-only rows

datasets.name: dim_offense
datasets.description: Offense dimension. One row per unique offense category + crime_against combination.

datasets.name: dim_agency
datasets.description: Police agency dimension. Normalized agency names with their primary county.

datasets.name: rpt_county_agency_crime_baseline
datasets.description: County Level KPI #1. Set a goal for each police agency within a given county to reduce crime by 5% within the next fiscal year, based on historical crime count baseline.

metrics.name: total_crimes
metrics.description: Crime incident count. Slice by any combination of geo/offense/agency/date dimensions to reproduce any of the old county- or city-level crime KPIs.

metrics.name: crime_avg_age
metrics.description: Average recorded age of individuals involved (source age_num is ~47% null; nulls are ignored by AVG, not clamped or filtered).

metrics.name: avg_median_household_income
metrics.description: KPI #2. Median household income; average across whatever years are in scope.

metrics.name: avg_per_capita_income
metrics.description: KPI #8. Per capita income; average across whatever years are in scope.

metrics.name: avg_total_population
metrics.description: Population is a point-in-time snapshot, not additive across years — always aggregated as an average, never summed.

metrics.name: counties_exceeding_10pct_growth_years

dialects.expression: SUM(case when population_growth_pct > 10 then 1 else 0 end)

metrics.description: KPI #4. Count of county-year rows where population growth exceeded 10%.

metrics.name: business_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN fct_business_subsidy_tiers.business_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.description: Count of Colorado businesses with an assigned B.A.S.E. tier, sliceable by tier/county/type.

metrics.name: subsidy_qualifying_business_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN qualifies_for_subsidy THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.description: Count of businesses that qualify for a B.A.S.E. subsidy (composite_tier >= 3).

metrics.name: notification_eligible_business_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN notification_eligible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.description: Count of businesses eligible for automated OEDIT notification.

metrics.name: crime_rate_per_100k
metrics.description: KPIs #3, #7, #9. Crimes per 100k residents, computed live from fct_crimes + fct_income_population — replaces three separate hand-computed crime_per_100k columns in the old oedit reports.

metrics.name: crime_to_population_ratio
metrics.description: Total crimes divided by average population, at whatever grain is queried (e.g. county + year). Joins fct_crimes and fct_income_population via the shared geo entity. Prefer crime_rate_per_100k below for a human-readable rate.

metrics.name: agency_total_crimes
metrics.description: County KPI #1. Total historical crime count per police agency.

metrics.name: agency_target_crimes_5pct_reduction
metrics.description: County KPI #1. Target crime count reflecting a 5% reduction goal per agency; additive across agencies.
